selection: Parameters fixed before new rollouts; no grid search. New seeds in the same five development layouts.
pairing: Fresh seeded reconfigure for every method; assert equality of simulator, controller and full initial observation hashes. Separate duplicate-SAC witness checks reset repeatability. Not a claim of arbitrary mid-trajectory restoration.
termination: 200 physical control steps even after first success; no artificial freezing or early-success metric inflation.
force_observability: Rules use prior returned current/past simulator contact signals, never candidate future outcomes. Additional privileged input versus pretrained SAC is explicitly diagnostic; later learned comparisons must match inputs.
force_units: Environment-defined accumulated contact quantity; do not relabel as a physical impulse integral.
reporting: Save all attempts and outcomes. Paired uncertainty conditional on these layouts/checkpoint; not final-test or training-seed generalization. No improvement guaranteed.
resources: GPU1 only; one process initially. Verify resource headroom before changing concurrency. Stop own work if disk free below 15 GiB.
